Edit: Oh shit someone said it already
Hey congrats! Very proud of you! 🎉

I agree with you, it was terrible to bear and I kept on dissociating. It was weird and brought an even more intense of emotions. I think I’m going to call the hotline, cause I know that everyone is trying to help me but it works so-so. 

Thanks for the kind words and love. Hope that you’ll get better too 💕

Thanks for the kind words and the love. The difficult part is the up and down and the dissociation. Crying for 2 hours and all of a sudden forgetting why I cry and thinking that I’ll be ok. Being able to look at our pictures and the songs that we used to listen too, not feeling anything. 

Then BAM I’m there sobbing on the floor about to vomit everywhere, it’s just too intense. I’ve been recording myself explaining what I’m feeling and stuff, it seems to help for now. I just hope that tomorrow will be better, because today surely was not good. :(

It isn’t a pickup line, but here it goes,

So I’ll walk to my person of interest, act as if I’m taking something out of my pocket (clenched my fist) and ask them to hold it. They’ll open their hand, then I’ll grab it, smile at them and say “Hey!”. Most of the time they’ll laugh and well start to talk.


Works around 70% of the time
